pages/home.html.content:
Practical self-study learning

Learn useful things. Prove what you know.

Structured modules, meaningful assessments and a course library that remembers your progress securely.

Browse courses Open my libraryCreate an account
Built for real learning

Read. Practise. Assess. Complete.

  • Course content split into clear modules
  • Server-recorded progress and grades
  • Secure passwordless access
  • Certificates for completed courses

Platform settings

Administrator overrides are stored in PostgreSQL. Where an override is absent, the LMS falls back to the corresponding value in .env.

Platform identity

Safe runtime settings may override their deployment defaults without editing .env.

Overrides APP_NAME. The same effective name is used by the web interface, API and outgoing email.
The permanent host organisation. It cannot be deleted, but its name is yours to control.
Initially defaults from APP_DOMAIN. Enter only the domain, for example prettythings.capetown.

SMTP / outgoing email

Database values override MAILER_DSN, MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS, MAIL_FROM_NAME and MAIL_REPLY_TO.

{{ @mail_settings.mail_override_active ? 'Database override' : '.env defaults' }}
Mail configuration needs attention. {{ @mail_settings.mail_configuration_error }}
{{ @mail_settings.smtp_password_configured ? 'A password is configured. Leave this blank to keep it.' : 'No SMTP password is currently configured.' }} Passwords saved here are encrypted using APP_KEY.
Leave blank to use the effective Platform name.
Optional. Leave blank to receive replies at the From address.
Advanced SMTP DSN options
Normally leave this unchanged. This preserves optional Symfony Mailer DSN query parameters.

Configuration model

The LMS deliberately separates deployment secrets from administrator-managed runtime settings.

Database-over-.env settings

Platform name and outgoing mail may be changed here. Removing an override returns that setting to its .env default.

Infrastructure remains in .env

Database credentials, APP_KEY, application URL/domain, cookie/security settings and filesystem/deployment configuration are not exposed in the web UI.
